blurb: Start Skydiving offers tandem skydiving experiences from their dropzone in Middletown, OH, located between Dayton and Cincinnati. They provide various pricing options including weekend and weekday tandems, high altitude jumps, and discounts for groups, students, first responders, and military members. The facility emphasizes safety, customer service, and a family-owned atmosphere.
